title: Independent reading: John 3:1–21
subtitle: Track dialogue, misunderstanding, and explanatory discourse.
overview: John 3 begins as dialogue and develops into extended explanation. Do not assume every question receives an immediate one-line answer; trace the discourse movement.
Conditions, ἵνα clauses, and contrast between light and darkness form the paragraph’s structural framework.

items.grc: ἐὰν μή τις γεννηθῇ ἄνωθεν, οὐ δύναται ἰδεῖν τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ θεοῦ.
items.en: Unless someone is born from above, he is not able to see the kingdom of God.

items.grc: οὕτως γὰρ ἠγάπησεν ὁ θεὸς τὸν κόσμον, ὥστε τὸν υἱὸν τὸν μονογενῆ ἔδωκεν.
items.en: For God so loved the world that he gave the only Son.
